build_started_at_source: Creation time (UTC) of the first shell artifact written by this build session (the repository listing command). The preceding specification reading (about 5 minutes) is not included, so first_* values are lower bounds relative to the true session start.
plan_ready_at_source: Timestamp when manifest.yaml, the runner, extractor, exporter and validator were all on disk; the smoke run had not started yet.

revisions.summary: Initial complete plan: robots-aware sitemap discovery with systematic sampling, JSON-LD variant prices, DOM description and specification blocks, 9-column CSV export, quality_exceptions, local validator.

First smoke run (2 products) exposed a 45 s navigation hang on the first product request. Replaced context.block_requests() with an explicit route filter that also aborts scripts, and lowered the navigation timeout to 30 s; the data is server-rendered so no fact depends on script execution. A 3-product smoke then finished 4 requests with no retry.

Fixed the known-defect stock-state handling found by run-001: only InStock/OutOfStock were mapped, so a product whose variants were PreOrder had an empty availability and a business-field missing reason. The mapping now covers InStock/LimitedAvailability/OnlineOnly, OutOfStock/SoldOut/Discontinued, PreOrder and BackOrder, and falls back to the visible .urgency[data-stockcode] stock line when the offers publish no state. In the same revision, tax_basis was moved out of missing_reasons into tax_basis_note, so quality_exceptions lists only docs/02 business fields. A defensive price-parser guard (reject ambiguous single-dot decimals in es-ES) was added while writing the contract tests.

build_errors.message: extract.py referenced CURRENCY without importing it from config; caught by the offline extraction check on two saved pages before any crawler run.
build_errors.fix: added the config import; re-ran the offline check successfully.

network_note: Build probes (robots.txt, sitemap.xml, two product pages, one category page) were plain curl requests spaced by 6-9 seconds from the same machine egress as the crawler. They are not part of the run counts. No proxy was configured for these probes; the harness HTTP(S)_PROXY variables were present and the browser used the platform default path.
